data.summary: The reviews show mixed signals. The positive reviews are recent, brief, and clustered, raising questions about authenticity. However, they contain some specific details. The single negative review is highly specific about a warranty follow-up failure, which is a credible complaint pattern for contractors. The extremely low total review count is unusual for an established pool builder.
fake_signals: Low review volume (7) for a pool contractor
Multiple 5-star reviews posted in same 3-month period
Generic, brief praise in several 5-star reviews
No 3-4 star reviews, creating a polarized rating distribution

negative_evidence: Customer reached out for warranty paperwork for Pentair LED light and never heard back

authentic_signals: Specific details in some reviews (project duration, crew names, putting green)
One negative review provides specific details (Pentair LED light, October timeframe)
